enrichment.core_claim: A three week remote mindfulness program improved source memory and inhibitory control accuracy, with increased frontal parietal theta and alpha EEG power.
enrichment.ask_question: Which parts of the mindfulness training do you think most drove the gains in source memory accuracy?
enrichment.challenge_question: With about 16 per group and several tasks, how confident are you these interaction effects will replicate in a larger preregistered sample?
